scope: D06 development-only pilot; Test 677 is not read
grouping: package union real campaign excluding generic individual buckets union nonempty largestChangedJsSha1 and changedJsSetSha1; malicious hashes only available
outer: 3 deterministic largest-malicious-first folds, remaining benign components balanced by class counts; all variants share folds
inner: outer training group-disjoint fit/calibration, seeded greedy target 25 percent of each class; report actual counts

features.M_full: all 29 source features, never metadata or identifiers
features.M_base_weighted: M_base with malicious 1/sqrt(fit campaign size), normalized malicious total; generic cases keyed by package
features.T_obf: single sklearn DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3, random_state=20261109), same M_obf15, native missing routing and fixed updateType codes

sanitization: only exact zeros in obfMeanIdentLengthNew/ChangedCode and obfWhitespaceRatioNew/ChangedCode -> NaN; Change zero is retained; this is a sensitivity, not a corrected ground truth
missingness: 29 isna indicators only, diagnostic not main comparison
shuffle: one fixed-seed permutation of fit labels only; calibration and outer labels remain original; diagnostic
threshold: normal calibration FP budget floor(n*target_fpr); prediction score >= nextafter((k+1)-th descending eligible score, +inf), conservative ties; report actual outer FPR
hybrid_calibration: calibrate total combined decision; rule-only FP above budget is impossible, no fake passed budget
report: largest three malicious components excluded sensitivity
context: deferred until a complete keyed context CSV and its feature/rule specification are available; missing rows never filled with zero
limits: D06 has already informed feature selection
only three outer folds with dominant components
native model files only; no pickle
